title: Virtua Fighter CG Portrait Series Vol. 5: Wolf Hawkfield
native_title: バーチャ・ファイター ＣＧポートレート・シリーズ Ｖｏｌ．５ 「ウルフ・ホークフィールド」
overview:
Character CG from Virtua Fighter and an image song blend together beautifully...

Volume 5 of the CG Portrait Series is devoted to the wrestler Wolf Hawkfield. Newly made computer graphics follow him from a snowy trek to a spotlit entrance and into the wrestling ring, in a sequence staged to his image song "Chain Reaction", a single from the Virtua Fighter 2 vocal album Dancing Shadows.

Choose "Karaoke" and the lyrics appear on screen so you can sing along.

- Original CG portraits of Wolf Hawkfield
- Image song with a karaoke mode

「バーチャファイター」のキャラクターCGとイメージソングが華麗に融合する…
